Subject: POC: Access & evaluation plan for Acme Media

Hi Laura / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion and appreciate the clarity on the editorial use cases and latency expectations. I wanted to capture the agreed POC scope, success criteria, timeline, and immediate access requests so we all have aligned owners. Please read through and flag anything I missed.

High-level POC scope (2-week trial):
- Use-case: generation + reranking for article summaries and headline suggestions (editorial workflow).
- Traffic profile: ~100 requests/day with 200–500 token responses; peak bursts up to 50 concurrent requests.
- Environment: staging environment connected to Acme editorial tools for evaluation only.

Primary success criteria (mutually agreed):
1) Latency — 95th percentile generation latency < 450ms for 200-token responses under our expected burst load.
2) Quality — editorial team rates generated headlines >= 4/5 on usefulness in at least 70% of sampled prompts (sample size = 200).
3) Stability — zero dropped connections and <0.5% error rate across all calls for the duration.

Evaluation plan & responsibilities:
- Acme: provide sample prompt set + labelled baseline results by EOD Thu (LA time). Owner: Laura.
- Redwood: provision staging API key, set up model variant (llama-variant-quant) and deploy sample endpoint. Owner: Jordan.
- Monitoring: Marissa will configure the dashboard and share token/cost estimates daily. Owner: Marissa.
- Infra/security: Vivek will coordinate IP allowlist/SSO and ensure logs are retained for 30 days. Owner: Vivek.

Timeline (target):
- Mar 8: Redwood provides staging API key + SSO invites.
- Mar 9–10: Acme connects editorial tooling and runs smoke tests.
- Mar 11–20: Active evaluation window (data collection).
- Mar 22: Joint review of results and go/no-go decision.

Immediate access requests (what we need from Acme to start):
1) Please confirm two staging users to invite via SSO (name + email).
2) Provide the list of egress IPs you will allow us to call from OR tell us the firewall rules we need to whitelist for Redwood (we can provide our outbound range).
3) Signed access acknowledgement (simple Doc) — I attached the POC plan and criteria; we can push a quick DocuSign if that helps.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (POC details), poc-success-criteria.xlsx (sample rubric).

Next steps: Laura to confirm users + sample prompts by Thu; we’ll ship credentials on Mar 8 and Marissa will share dashboard invite.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
